description: List a product, tool or website in the AI Startup Hub directory. Returns the slug and the URL of a server-rendered, indexable page that carries a dofollow backlink to the submitted url. The url must be publicly reachable. No API key needed; limit 10 submissions per hour per IP, 3 products per host.

category.description: One lowercase category, e.g. ai, developer-tools, saas, open-source, api, automation

description.description: One or two sentences on what the product does, max 5000 chars

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the product homepage

name: submit_product
